# tiles

Tiles view: slot-stable grid, strip, tile drag, density, snapshot-not-live rule.

Read first: `docs/features/tiles/spec.md`, `docs/features/tiles/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows` — End, Resume and Remove live in a mainhead above the focused terminal and in hover-revealed action rows on rail cards and tile footers, behind confirm dialogs. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows.md`
- `kb:adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type` — Internal tile and rail reorder drags carry a Muster-specific MIME type instead of text/plain, so a dragover can tell a reorder from dragged text. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: drop, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-new-session-button-in-masthead` — One New session button sits in the masthead beside the view switcher, visible in both views; the rail head and the Tiles toolbar lose theirs. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: launch, views, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/launch-new-session-button-in-masthead.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-opens-launched-session` — A successful launch opens the launched session: Focus focuses it, and both views move keyboard focus into its terminal. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/launch-opens-launched-session.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-attention-order-your-turn-before-active` — Attention order puts every state that waits on the user first — needs input, failed, unread idle, started — then planning and working, then read idle last. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail, shortcuts, tiles) → `docs/adr/rail-attention-order-your-turn-before-active.md`
- `kb:adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins` — A post-launch rename is a Muster-owned nullable title override that wins over the status-line name; the wire title is the display title. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: rename, tiles, focus) → `docs/adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-attach-target` — The one-live-client law is per attach target, not per session: a session's Claude socket and shell socket coexist and never supersede each other. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-attach-target.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-control-in-tile-footer` — The tile's surface control lives in the footer action row, not the specced header, because a header control truncated every title at the dense grid. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, tiles) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-control-in-tile-footer.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-drag-reorder-header-handle-insert-shift` — Tiles reorder by dragging the tile header only; a drop on another tile inserts and shifts, never swaps, with neutral feedback and no daemon involvement. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-drag-reorder-header-handle-insert-shift.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-launched-session-promoted-into-grid` — A session launched from Tiles is promoted into the live grid, demoting the lowest-priority tile when full, rather than admitted only if a slot is free. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: tiles, launch) → `docs/adr/tiles-launched-session-promoted-into-grid.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-order-ephemeral-per-window` — Tile order is per-window and ephemeral, held with grid membership in client state; nothing is persisted and the protocol is untouched. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-order-ephemeral-per-window.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-slot-stable-grid-never-self-sorts` — The Tiles grid never re-sorts itself by attention: a promoted session takes the demoted tile's slot, survivors keep their order, only the user reorders. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-slot-stable-grid-never-self-sorts.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-sticky-live-membership` — Tiles grid membership is computed at view entry and density change only; afterwards only user action changes it, so a terminal never vanishes mid-keystroke. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-sticky-live-membership.md`
- `kb:adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers` — The dashboard has two peer views, Focus and Tiles, switched from the masthead or a chord, with the choice persisted daemon-side. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: views, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers.md`
- `kb:lesson/refactor-moved-dom-attach-after-layout-call` — A shared reorder pass attached new tiles after their first refit, a silent no-op on a detached node; the only symptom was a 1-in-60 E2E flake. (active, 2026-09-24; features: tiles) → `docs/lessons/refactor-moved-dom-attach-after-layout-call.md`
- `kb:lesson/tiles-never-refit-behind-pattern-match` — No tile ever sent a resize frame while footers pattern-matched geometry and passed; five Criticals lived in the second view the plan's source states omitted. (active, 2026-08-23; features: tiles, surfaces) → `docs/lessons/tiles-never-refit-behind-pattern-match.md`
